title: TCI Configuration
description: Configuration for managing TCI internet and telephone subscriptions, including account credentials and payment cards.

accounts.title: TCI Accounts
accounts.description: TCI accounts indexed by their telephone number or subscription identifier.

additionalProperties.title: TCI Account
additionalProperties.description: Credentials and payment preferences for a TCI subscription.

password.title: Account Password
password.description: Password used to authenticate with the TCI customer portal.

payment_card.title: Payment Card
payment_card.description: Identifier of the card in the top-level cards object that should be used to pay this account's bills.

propertyNames.title: Account Identifier
propertyNames.description: Telephone number or subscription identifier used to identify the TCI account.

cards.title: Payment Cards
cards.description: Bank cards available for paying TCI bills, indexed by a user-defined identifier.

additionalProperties.title: Payment Card
additionalProperties.description: Bank card credentials used by the TCI payment gateway.

number.title: Card Number
number.description: 16-digit bank card number (Primary Account Number or PAN). Stored as a string to preserve leading zeros.

cvv2.title: CVV2
cvv2.description: Card verification code printed on the bank card. Usually 3 or 4 digits.

expiry.title: Card Expiration Date
expiry.description: Card expiration date in the Iranian Solar Hijri calendar, formatted as YYYY/MM.

second_password.title: Static Second Password
second_password.description: Static online payment password (رمز دوم ثابت). This is not the dynamic one-time password (رمز پویا) sent by SMS or generated by a banking application.

propertyNames.title: Card Identifier
propertyNames.description: User-defined identifier used to reference this card from an account's payment_card field.
